gloss: one step; a small amount of progress

definitions.explanation: A single step or pace when walking.
Figuratively, a small advancement or movement toward a goal.

examples.japanese: {一歩|いっぽ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{動|うご}けなかった→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't move a single step.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一歩|いっぽ}⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{見|み}ていた→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一歩|いっぽ}⟦{近|ちか}づいた→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧。
examples.english: I got one step closer to my dream.

examples.japanese: ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧{一歩|いっぽ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{踏|ふ}み{出|だ}した→踏み出す：14283_fumidasu⟧。
examples.english: We took the first step toward reform.

examples.japanese: ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一歩|いっぽ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
examples.english: I gain experience as a step toward success.

notes:
{一歩|いっぽ} means both a literal single step and figurative progress.

COMMON PATTERNS (Sense 1):
- {一歩|いっぽ}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: one step forward
- {一歩|いっぽ}⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧: one step back
- {一歩|いっぽ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{引|ひ}かない→引く：01978_hiku⟧: not give an inch
- {一歩|いっぽ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{動|うご}けない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧: cannot move at all

FIGURATIVE EXPRESSIONS (Sense 2):
- ⟦{第|だい}→第〜：03960_dai⟧{一歩|いっぽ}: first step
- {一歩|いっぽ}{一歩|いっぽ}: step by step
- {一歩|いっぽ}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to be one step ahead
- {一歩|いっぽ}⟦{手前|てまえ}→手前：01001_temae⟧: one step short of, on the verge of

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{二歩|にほ}→二歩：27347_niho⟧: two steps (also illegal move in shogi)
- ⟦{何歩|なんぽ}→何歩：27348_nanpo⟧: how many steps
